questions.question: What contradiction does Marek notice when he looks at his own company after years?
answers: Between offices in different cities
Between the original mission and the reality of running the business, increasingly focused on the pay check and growth
Between paper and digital documents
Between IT and sales
questions.explanation: This crack between the idea and the practice sets the whole story in motion.

questions.question: Why does the OpenAI story move Marek so strongly?
answers: Because he wants to buy Microsoft shares
Because he sees in it a reflection of his own conflict between mission and business
Because he plans to fire his board
Because he doesn't like startups
questions.explanation: In the events around Sam Altman he recognises his own questions about meaning and responsibility.

questions.question: What is AI Brain Fry in the text?
answers: A new ranking algorithm
Mental fatigue resulting from the constant juggling of AI tools
A program for automating work
A type of server failure
questions.explanation: The report and the conversation with Agnieszka define it as cognitive overload.

questions.question: What solution does Marek propose against the chaos of AI tools?
answers: To follow every novelty even faster
To choose a few truly important tools and let go of FOMO
To ban AI in the company
To leave the decision entirely to the HR department
questions.explanation: His prescription is to limit the number of tools and have a common strategy.

questions.question: What role does "context" play in the last part of the text?
answers: It is the name of the company's new product
It reminds us that solutions must be adapted to the scale, market and realities of one's own company
It means only the US political situation
It is used to explain accounting
questions.explanation: Marek explains that knowledge from big corporations does not work automatically everywhere.
